sourceText:
Citrus Sunset
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 6:57pm

Ingredients




1 pkt JELL-O Brand Gelatin, any red flavor
1 pkt Sugar-Free JELL-O Orange Flavor Gelatin

Preparation

1 Prepare JELL-O red gelatin as directed. Pour into 8 dessert glasses. 2 Refrigerate about 1 hour or until set but not firm. Meanwhile, prepare JELL-O Orange Flavor Gelatin as directed. Refrigerate about 30 minutes or until slightly thickened. Spoon evenly over red gelatin in each glass. Refrigerate about 2 hours or until firm. Garnish with an orange twist.
